scope: Android device gate after a repeated, already-solved ADB authorization failure

hypothesis.claim: An executable preflight, hash-verified deploy and authorized-only install with screenshot prevent both the authorization repeat and false deployment claims
hypothesis.disconfirming_result: An install or visual claim is produced without an authorized target, or a corrupted copy passes

decision.why: Text-only reference lessons were not applied; a gate with exit codes and evidence is
rejected: Checklist text only (already existed in the references)

change.summary: tools/android_deploy.ps1 (preflight, read-back hash, authorized install, foreground and screenshot), DEPLOYMENT.md, DR-0015 addendum, lesson records, progress log
change.scope_authority: Owner 2026-10-19: document the error and how the other projects circumvented it

commands: tools/android_deploy.ps1 -Install (GATE-1 unauthorized, GATE-2 preview1, GATE-3 preview2)
positive: GATE-3: device, copy hash match, install passed, foreground, visible screenshot
negative: GATE-1: unauthorized, install blocked and not claimed
GATE-2: launch passed but black screen, caught by screenshot review

what_worked: Reference records identified the fix immediately

reuse.reuse_applied: Reference playbook sections 1, 6 and 10, R3 section 5, A-LRN-016/017/043

lessons.transferable_rule: Turn every known operational failure from a reference project into an executable gate with evidence, run at session start

next_action.action: Run the preflight at the start of every Android session
